scope: Gemma 4 OQ8 full-model comparisons against the pinned Transformers BF16 oracle
contract_revision: The first valid exact-prompt OQ8 base-short measurement was adopted as the Phase 5 baseline by explicit plan revision after it was observed.

application.hidden_capture_points: Every selected decoder boundary, including local and global layers and the final pre-norm state
application.logit_positions: Every committed comparison position, not only the final prompt token

rationale: These exact observed OQ8 values are the revised broad functional baseline. They permit Phase 5 to advance beyond base-short while preserving exact greedy decisions, exact final argmax, full top-5 overlap, and finite outputs. They are not claimed to have been frozen before observing the candidate and must not be weakened after this revision. The final OQ8++ stage uses the separate narrower oq8pp-thresholds.json contract.
